name: thinking-weather
description: A pixel-art valley behind the conversation: society advances from the Stone Age to a sci-fi future as the context fills and falls back at compaction, while the weather follows Claude (storms, lightning per tool call), the clock, the seasons and your town's real weather

place.title: Town for real weather
place.description: The sky follows the real weather here (looked up on Open-Meteo; only the town's rounded coordinates are sent after the first lookup). Leave empty for a clear sky. "Town, Region" picks among towns of the same name.
